ayahOccurrences.text: وَتَرَى ٱلْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِىَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ ٱلسَّحَابِ ۚ صُنْعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَتَرَى ٱلْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِىَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ ٱلسَّحَابِ ۚ صُنْعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form IV) perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: أَتْقَنَ is in the derivative form: أَتْقَنَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ت/ق/ن   t–q–n dregs of a well, to dredge up a well; nature; to do something well, to be skilful, to be eloquent; to perfect, perfection. Of this root, أَتْقَنَ ʾatqana occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
أَتْقَنَ ʾatqana [v. IV, trans.] to perfect

(27:88) وَتَرَى الْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِ صُنْعَ اللَّهِ الَّذِي أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ and you will see the mountains, deeming them standing still, when [in fact] they are passing by like the passing of clouds; [this is] the handiwork of God who has perfected all things.
